moonlit-night-branches-v1.png.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: very small upper-right game-dialog specimen, displayed around 100 by 80 pixels on a warm cream card. Primary request: replace a visually dense moonlit grove with an extremely simple, instantly legible night scene. Subject: one large pale full moon against a clear deep indigo-blue patch of night sky, framed by only two or three dark fruit-tree branch silhouettes entering from the lower-left and upper-right edges, with a few simple leaf clusters. Style/medium: restrained watercolor and gouache botanical illustration, soft pigment texture, high contrast, elegant and calm, matching a hand-painted nature journal. Composition/framing: compact horizontal oval or softly organic vignette; moon is the dominant shape and occupies about one third of the image height; branches act as a sparse frame and never cross the moon; strong silhouette readable at thumbnail size; generous transparent margin around the vignette. Lighting/mood: quiet, nocturnal, serene. Color palette: deep indigo, blue-black branches, muted blue-green leaves, warm ivory moon. Constraints: genuinely transparent outside the compact vignette; no text, no stars, no mist, no fireflies, no fruit, no animals, no people, no buildings, no border, no card, no UI, no watermark; avoid dense foliage and fine detail; nothing touches the outer canvas edges.

moonlit-grove-v1.png.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent painted UI specimen for the top-right corner of a field-journal game dialog. Primary request: a beautiful moonlit grove of several old fruit trees at night, seen as a small intimate woodland vignette. Scene/backdrop: no rectangular scene or horizon panel; the grove itself fades organically at the edges into transparency. Subject: a clustered grove of varied fruit-tree silhouettes, overlapping leafy crowns, a slim crescent moon visible through the upper branches, faint low mist and a few tiny firefly-like points of light. Style/medium: detailed warm watercolor and gouache natural-history illustration, delicate organic edges, subtle paper-like pigment texture only within the painted subject, matching refined botanical watercolor game specimens. Composition/framing: compact landscape-shaped vignette, readable at roughly 100 by 80 pixels, strong unified silhouette, generous transparent margins, no element touching the canvas edge. Lighting/mood: deep indigo and muted blue-green moonlight, tranquil and mysterious, restrained warm highlights, not frightening. Constraints: genuine transparent background and alpha; no text, labels, border, card, frame, UI, people, buildings, animals, watermark, or opaque paper background; keep the grove readable when downscaled.

fungal-threats.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: transparent three-specimen watercolor source sheet for small game encounter portraits. Primary request: create three clearly separated botanical pathology vignettes in one horizontal row, each independently readable and extractable, with wide completely transparent gutters between them. Left—Fungal Blight: a small fruit-tree twig with mottled curling leaves, pale lesions, and delicate white mycelial threads. Center—Damp Rot: a tender young green seedling stem at a tiny wet root collar, with subtle pale mold and dark softened tissue creeping upward. Right—Spores on the Damp Air: a wounded fruit-tree leaf and short twig with a graceful cloud of tiny ochre-gray spores settling onto the wound. Style: refined warm watercolor and gouache natural-history illustration with delicate organic edges. Exactly three non-overlapping subjects in equal-width thirds, generous transparent margins, natural muted palette, clear at 96 by 88 pixels. Genuine transparent background; no text, dividers, frames, panels, cast shadows, watermark, people, animals, border, or opaque paper background; no subject crosses into another third.
